title: studio: the view and page-block filter builder drops each field's options, so a picklist column gets a free-text value box
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by the #36169 dev (recorded on #36169, comment 7069111477), outside that card's surface.

## What happens
`objectCatalogOf`, `ViewVariantInspector` and `PageBlockInspector` (Studio metadata-admin) build the filter builder's field list without each field's `options`, so on a `select` (picklist) field the value control is a free-text box instead of the option picker. An author can type a value that is not one of the options, and the saved filter then matches nothing, with no error.

## Done when
These three builders pass the field's `options` like the editors fixed in #36165 / #36182, so a picklist offers its options; a pin on a `select` field with a text-field control.

reach: Studio form (a saved view variant or page-block filter on a picklist field), by code reading; to be measured once by the claimant.
Business reason: a list view or page block filtered on a picklist in Studio can silently show no rows because of a typed value that is not an option.
Reader: a domain:ui lane (Studio metadata-admin widgets).
Dedupe: `objectCatalogOf options` → 0 hits.
Grade: p2 — silently empty results from a common authoring path; same family as #36169.
